highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 updates to Skia m152 and adds Graphite GPU bindings with asynchronous pixel readback.
highlights_body: The release expands GPU integration, improves native package support, and fixes resource-lifetime issues while reducing common managed allocation overhead.

bullets.lead: Skia updated through Chrome M152 servicing
bullets.detail: The bundled renderer advances from late M151 stability fixes to the Chrome M152 engine and its subsequent servicing updates.
Adds Graphite bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn so applications can integrate Skia's newer GPU rendering backend.
SKImage and SKSurface now provide backend-neutral asynchronous RequestReadPixels APIs for non-blocking pixel retrieval.

bullets.lead: Pixel and region objects retain their native sources
bullets.detail: Fixes native use-after-free failures involving SKRegion span iteration and SKPixmap subsets or transformed pixmaps.
Fixes raster-image allocation cleanup, HarfBuzz blob conversion cleanup, and replacement uniform-buffer disposal.
Reduces unnecessary copies, boxing, reflection, and lookup-map growth in text, data, runtime-effect, and tag operations.

bullets.lead: HarfBuzz shaping avoids defensive feature-array copies
bullets.detail: Font shaping no longer creates an unnecessary defensive Feature array copy.
Restores production availability of SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET and validates its Vulkan integration across Android and Linux.
Nano Server native packages use FreeType to provide font support on that platform.

bullets.lead: Apple native symbols included in package builds
bullets.detail: Apple native symbol packages are produced during packing to improve native-symbol availability for Apple deployments.

contributor_summaries.jeffska: Nano Server font support through FreeType
contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn

preview_summaries.v4.152.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 introduced the Chrome M152 engine update, Graphite GPU bindings, asynchronous pixel readback, and the Vulkan Silk.NET package. It also delivered native resource-lifetime fixes and Nano Server font support.
preview_summaries.v4.152.0-rc.1.26426.14: Release Candidate 1 added the M152 servicing update, restored production packaging for Vulkan Silk.NET, and improved runtime resource cleanup and allocation behavior.

harfbuzz_summary: Improves HarfBuzz Font.Shape allocation behavior and native resource cleanup, while refreshing package documentation and native package symbol handling.

v4.152.0-preview.1.1.headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 Preview 1 introduces the Skia m152 engine update, Graphite bindings, and asynchronous pixel readback.
v4.152.0-preview.1.1.body: It also adds the Vulkan Silk.NET package, Nano Server font support, and fixes several native resource-lifetime issues.

v4.152.0-rc.1.26426.14.headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 Release Candidate 1 advances the M152 servicing update and restores Vulkan Silk.NET package production.
v4.152.0-rc.1.26426.14.body: The candidate also improves native resource cleanup, package symbols, and managed allocation behavior.

v4.152.0.headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 incorporates the latest Chrome M152 servicing update.
